title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 27. Urges the Commission to ensure the full and correct implementation of the European Media Freedom Act; stresses that the failure of Member States to enforce the provisions of the European Media Freedom Act constitutes a breach of Union law, and calls on the Commission to promptly initiate infringement procedures where non-compliance is found, particularly with regard to the independence requirements for national regulatory authorities and to the prohibition of political interference in public service media newsrooms; further urges the Commission and the Member States to guarantee the swift and proper implementation of the Anti-SLAPP Directive and to take effective measures to put an end to all SLAPP cases across the EU;
